import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_sub.shape}")

# Feature columns (192 features: 64 margin + 64 shape + 64 texture)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]

print(f"Feature columns count: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Prepare training data
X_train = train_df[feature_cols]
y_train = train_df["species"]
X_test = test_df[feature_cols]
test_ids = test_df["id"]

print(f"Unique species in train: {y_train.nunique()}")

# 80/20 hold-out validation split - must be before final model training
X_train_fold, X_val, y_train_fold, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.20, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Feature scaling - StandardScaler on training fold only (no data leakage)
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_fold)
X_val_scaled = scaler.transform(X_val)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test)

print(
    f"Scaler mean range: [{X_train_scaled.min().min():.4f}, {X_train_scaled.max().max():.4f}]"
)
print(
    f"Scaler std range: [{X_train_scaled.std().min():.4f}, {X_train_scaled.std().max():.4f}]"
)

# LightGBM Classifier with early stopping (atomic improvement)
lgb_clf = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,  # Increased upper bound for early stopping to work
    max_depth=5,
    num_leaves=31,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    n_jobs=-1,
    seed=42,
    class_weight="balanced",
    verbose=-1,
    early_stopping_rounds=50,
    force_col_wise=True,
)
lgb_clf.fit(X_train_scaled, y_train_fold, eval_set=[(X_val_scaled, y_val)])

print(f"Best iteration: {lgb_clf.best_iteration_}")

# Validate using MULTI-CLASS LOG LOSS on hold-out set
y_val_pred = lgb_clf.predict_proba(X_val_scaled)
# Ensure probability bounds to avoid log(0)
eps = 1e-15
y_val_pred = np.clip(y_val_pred, eps, 1 - eps)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss (with Early Stopping): {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_pred_proba = lgb_clf.predict_proba(X_test_scaled)
test_pred_proba = np.clip(test_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)

# Create submission with CORRECT column ordering
submission_species = list(sample_sub.columns[1:])

# Map model prediction order to submission column order
class_to_idx = {cls: i for i, cls in enumerate(lgb_clf.classes_)}
col_to_idx = {col: class_to_idx[col] for col in submission_species}

# Create submission dataframe - ensure ID column matches test IDs exactly
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids})

# Add species columns in the correct order from sample submission
for species in submission_species:
    idx = col_to_idx[species]
    submission[species] = test_pred_proba[:, idx]

# Verify submission format matches sample submission
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Submission columns: {submission.columns.tolist()[:5]}...")
print(f"Columns match: {list(submission.columns) == list(sample_sub.columns)}")
print(f"ID values match: {(submission['id'] == sample_sub['id']).all()}")

# Save to required path
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(
    f"Submission has {submission.shape[1]} columns (id + {len(submission_species)} species)"
)
print(f"Submission has {submission.shape[0]} rows")
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")
